test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row. T and U have one person in between them. V is immediate right to P. Q is immediate left to U. There is one person between S and P. S is not the neighbour of V. V and U have two persons between them. R is immediate left to P. Which person is sitting exactly in the middle of the row?
solution: **Given: ** Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row. Let' suppose they all are facing in north. • V is immediate right to P and R is immediate left to P. • There is one person between S and P. • S is not the neighbour of V.
